claims.statement: Pure same-species single-j, fixed v: even-L>0 one-body electric RME has factor (Omega-n)/(Omega-v), v<Omega, only along allowed n=v,v+2,...,2Omega-v. Accessible half-filling cancels these amplitudes. Odd-rank magnetic operators are quasispin scalars; M1 proportional to J cannot be extended to all odd ranks. Unit single-particle M3 RME gives |RME|^2=264/247 for j11/2,n6,v2,10→8, but pure pairing degeneracy and unspecified actual energy ordering prohibit treating this as a measured decay.

claims.statement: nu=|Delta K|-L>0 and f_nu=FW^(1/nu); Tgamma=tau ln2 (1+alpha)/b_tot with total branch including conversion. No universal f_nu threshold identifies triaxiality; Coriolis/configuration/near-degenerate mixing and both-state interference remain alternatives.

claims.statement: Under incoherent stationary branching, Pi_x(a)=sum_br [Gamma_ab^(r)/Gamma_tot(a)]Pi_(x-r)(b). Augmented count labels are one implementation; mass labels/generating functions can retain counts equivalently. Final absorption normalization is distinct from finite-window probability. Conditional beta normalization requires b_beta>0. Neutral R-matrix P_l=rho/(F_l^2+G_l^2) gives threshold power with a nonzero limiting reduced width for a nonzero leading coefficient; bounded width still implies vanishing neutron width; gamma competition depends on nonzero radiation width and model parameters.

claims.statement: For nonnegative rates d=aD2+bD1+D1D2>0 iff every fixed nonnegative source admits a unique globally attracting nonnegative steady state. d=0 can admit source-specific families. Delta=0 iff ab=0 and a-b+D1-D2=0, including one-way defective cases. Passive source-free positivity and total-population monotonicity give boundedness. Equal-loss fraction relaxation requires a+b>0 and nonzero total population. Born–Markov/secular weak-coupling assumptions are a conditional Lindblad derivation, not mathematical necessities.
